projection.name: vault
projection.title: HashiCorp Vault
projection.description: Vault browser for secret engines, KV v1 and v2 secrets with versions and metadata, auth methods, policies, tokens, leases, namespaces, and audit devices.

fields.label: Namespace
fields.help: Vault Enterprise namespace this connection starts in. Leave empty for the root namespace.

fields.label: AppRole credential
fields.help: Reusable AppRole role ID and secret ID; the plugin logs in at connect time.

fields.label: AppRole mount
fields.help: Auth mount path the AppRole method is enabled at.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks secret writes, policy changes, token creation, and every revoke or destroy operation.

config.emptyText: This engine does not keep secret versions.

fields.label: Path
fields.help: Full path including the secrets engine mount, for example secret/team/app.

fields.label: Data
fields.help: JSON object of key/value pairs stored at this path.

fields.label: Check-and-set version
fields.help: KV v2 only. Write only when the current version matches; 0 requires the secret to be new.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this secret? KV v2 keeps the versions until they are destroyed; KV v1 removes the value immediately.

actions.label: Delete versions
actions.confirmText: Delete these versions? They keep their data and can be undeleted until they are destroyed.

fields.label: Versions to delete
fields.help: Comma-separated KV v2 version numbers. A deleted version keeps its data until it is destroyed.

actions.label: Destroy versions
actions.confirmText: Permanently destroy these versions? The data cannot be recovered.

fields.label: Versions to destroy
fields.help: Comma-separated KV v2 version numbers. Destroyed data cannot be recovered.

actions.label: Destroy secret
actions.confirmText: Permanently destroy every version and the metadata of this secret?

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this ACL policy? Tokens that reference it lose those capabilities.

fields.label: Orphan token
fields.help: Orphan tokens survive revocation of the creating token.

actions.label: Revoke
actions.confirmText: Revoke this token? Every secret and lease it created is revoked with it.

actions.label: Revoke
actions.confirmText: Revoke this lease? The credential it issued stops working immediately.
